Policy §6 permits stopping at probability <= 0.15 supported by at least two independent pieces of evidence; five are present here.

case.summary: Alert HHG-007 rests entirely on a 0.87 real-time model score for a $111.92 card-present purchase in region 264. That transaction is unremarkable on every structural dimension: 0.9x the card's mean amount, the card's dominant channel and product (91.1% each), its home region with 2,220 prior transactions, no new device or region flag, and uninterrupted home activity on every day of the preceding week (27 transactions within 48h). The two large in-person charges in the window ($2,254.95 and $2,529.78) sit at the card's established 180d maximum and scored 0.04 and 0.54 respectively; on a card averaging ~13 transactions a day they read as ordinary high-ticket spend, not an episode. The card's own history includes confirmed fraud (CC-0104, CC-3821, CC-1524), but each of those was defined by out-of-region or mixed-channel activity that is absent here, and a comparable high-score alert on this same card (CC-0657, $1,769.94 at 0.90) was cleared by the cardholder. No rare shared device profile and no region-newcomer link touches this card, so the wider ring of cards with confirmed fraud is not implicated. Verdict: legitimate, 0.12.
